title: QDCVR Component Ablation — Waterfall Chart
description: Waterfall chart showing P@5 degradation as each QDCVR component is removed. Starting from QDCVR-Full (P@5 = 0.875), each bar shows the cumulative effect of removing that component. Content verification is the largest single contributor.

ablation_steps.removed_description: Per-candidate content scoring (0-8 scale) with threshold >= 6
ablation_steps.explanation: Without content verification, high-vector false positives pass through. Industrial defect detection papers contaminate medical imaging queries (Q3 worst case).

ablation_steps.removed_description: Content-based KB attribution with sub-KB priority
ablation_steps.explanation: Without proper KB assignment, documents go to wrong KBs. RL polymer electrolyte misclassified to Energy-Batteries instead of Materials-ML-InverseDesign.

ablation_steps.removed_description: Restrict search to domain-relevant KB collection
ablation_steps.explanation: Reverts to flat search across all 13,649 chunks. Cross-domain pollution returns. Equivalent to B1 baseline (Vector-only flat search).

ablation_steps.removed_description: Intent parsing, term expansion, domain hint detection
ablation_steps.explanation: Ambiguous queries lose disambiguation. 'Efficient DL' no longer expanded to distinguish medical imaging from industrial defect detection.

ablation_steps.removed_description: Ensure small KBs represented in recall
ablation_steps.explanation: Large KBs (Materials-ML 1,390 chunks) dominate recall. Small KBs (Cooking 48 chunks) lose representation. Minor overall impact.
Only affects operational/experience-type queries. No impact on document retrieval queries in benchmark.

ablation_steps.removed_description: Explicit statement of retrieval coverage gaps
ablation_steps.explanation: No P@5 impact. Affects answer completeness and transparency only, not retrieval quality.

flat_baseline_reference.name: B1: Flat Vector (no organization)
flat_baseline_reference.note: Removing all organizational components converges to flat vector baseline

content_threshold.notes: Threshold 6 balances precision vs recall. Lower thresholds let more false positives through.

score_threshold.notes: 0.35 is the sweet spot. Higher values lose marginal-relevance documents.

stage1_top_k.notes: k=20 provides sufficient recall for content verification. Diminishing returns beyond 20.

metadata.key_insight: Organization (archiving + domain scoping) and verification (content scoring) are complementary: organization prevents cross-domain pollution at ingestion, verification catches residual errors at retrieval.
